subject: Request: Extended credits for Private VPC POC - FinHealth
messages:
From: Anna Peters <anna.peters@finhealth.io>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@finhealth.io>
Date: Thu, 10 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC POC — request for extended credits due to security gating

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really useful. We discussed running a short Private VPC POC to validate integration with our data controls and key management. Two asks from our security team came up that will extend the POC timeline by ~2–3 weeks:

- Time to complete our internal review of your SOC2 evidence and network diagram.
- Additional end-to-end tests with our KMS and audit logging turned on.

Given the extra time, would Redwood be open to extending the trial window and granting additional complimentary credits specifically for the Private VPC POC? This would help us finish the security gating without being constrained by the trial cap.

We can sign an MoU if needed and attach the POC scope of work. Happy to hop on a call with your security team early next week.

Best,
Anna Peters
Sr. Director, IT Security
FinHealth Inc.

Attachment: poc-sow.docx (SOW stub)

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Peters <anna.peters@finhealth.io>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC POC — request for extended credits due to security gating

Hi Anna — really appreciate the clear ask and the SOW.

Short answer: yes, we can make this work. I need to confirm two things with our internal teams:
1) Security sign-off on sharing SOC2 evidence and the VPC diagram (we typically share SOC2 Type II and redacted infra diagrams under NDA).
2) Finance/ops sign-off for a one-time credit extension scoped to the Private VPC POC.

Looping in Vivek (security) and Diego (solutions) to quickly validate the checklist and estimate the extra credits needed. Vivek — can you confirm what evidence we can share and any extra steps required? Diego — if you can estimate token/GPU credit impact for a 3-week extended test (approx), that will help expedite approval.

I will follow up with a formal note once we have the numbers.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC POC — request for extended credits due to security gating

Neha/Diego —

We can share the SOC2 Type II report and a redacted VPC diagram. I attached the current SOC2 PDF and the redacted network diagram that we use for POCs. We will need:
- a signed NDA/LoU confirming the artifacts are used only for the POC
- FinHealth's security contact to confirm receipt (Kevin copied on earlier thread)

On the audit side, enabling customer-managed KMS for the POC is supported but will require configuration help from Diego's team for the key policies and audit log forwarding.

Vivek
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2024.pdf, vpc_network_diagram.png

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Peters <anna.peters@finhealth.io>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC POC — request for extended credits due to security gating

Thanks Vivek — adding a quick implementation note for scope.

Estimate for a 3-week Private VPC POC with KMS + audit log verification: approx 20 GPU-hours (burst-enabled) and ~35M tokens processed for integration testing and sample workloads. Based on our internal rate card, that equates to roughly $18k of platform credits. There may be additional hours for onboarding assistance (we usually allocate a solutions-hour buffer of ~8 hours).

If Finance approves, we can scope an approval memo for a $20k credit grant tied to this deal and a two-week trial extension (from the original expiry). The credits would be one-time and only apply to the account used for the POC.

- Diego
Solutions Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: $20k credit for FinHealth Private VPC POC (conditional)

Quick note — reviewed Diego's estimate and Vivek's checklist. Approve a one-time $20,000 credit tied to deal D-78342, conditional on:
1) Signed LoU/NDA confirming limited use of SOC2 artifacts.
2) POC account flagged so credits can't be used on hosted API.
3) Solutions to file a short approval-memo in the deal record (attach to HubSpot).

Marcus — please process the credit and attach the approval-memo.pdf to the HubSpot deal. Neha — once Marcus confirms, please send the formal confirmation to Anna with the attachments and required next steps.

Aditya
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Peters <anna.peters@finhealth.io>
Cc: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@finhealth.io>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Apr 2025 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC POC — request for extended credits due to security gating

Hi Anna — great to confirm next steps.

We have approved a one-time $20,000 credit to support your Private VPC POC (deal D-78342). Conditions and next steps:
- What we are granting: $20k platform credits limited to the POC account, valid for the extended POC window only.
- Trial extension: we are extending the POC window by 14 days from the original expiry date.
- Security artifacts: Vivek attached our SOC2 Type II and a redacted VPC diagram. Please confirm receipt and return a signed LoU/NDA; we will not proceed with further artifact exchange until we have that on file.
- Implementation: Diego's team will schedule a 1:1 onboarding session to configure customer-managed KMS and audit log forwarding. Expect calendar invites in the next 48 hours.

Attachments: approval-memo.pdf, SOC2_Type2_2024.pdf, vpc_network_diagram.png

Link to HubSpot deal and approval: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/78342 (approval memo attached).

Please reply with the signed LoU and preferred times for Diego's team next week.

Thanks and looking forward —
Neha Kapoor
